description: Purpose: the citable safety-boundary layer for strength training - look up an exercise x condition pair and get a graded verdict (avoid / precaution / safe-with-modification / recommended / ineffective-for-target) together with the verbatim source quote, the section locator and a content hash for each citation. This is the wedge of the fitness domain: it answers 'is this movement contraindicated for this condition' rather than 'what should I train'. Guidelines: pass exercise and/or condition as an id (fit-ex-*, fit-cond-*) or as a keyword in Chinese or English; optionally filter by verdict; every row carries at least one retrievable source with a quote you can check character-for-character. Limits: **no individualised advice** (never 'what should I do'), no diagnosis, no dosing; this is a curated source-backed subset, so the absence of a pair is NOT evidence that the pair is safe; paid standards and copyrighted books are represented by metadata only and their body text is never reproduced. Ex: query_safety_boundaries(exercise='深蹲'), query_safety_boundaries(condition='osteoporosis'), query_safety_boundaries(verdict='avoid', response_format='json'), query_safety_boundaries(exercise='fit-ex-bench-press', condition='fit-cond-uncontrolled-hypertension').

condition.description: 条件：id（如 fit-cond-osteoporosis）或关键词（如 '妊娠' / 'osteoporosis'）

exercise.description: 动作：id（如 fit-ex-back-squat）或关键词（如 '深蹲' / 'deadlift'）

offset.description: 分页偏移（默认 0；把 next_cursor 原样回传即可翻页）

verdict.description: 按裁定等级过滤（可选）：avoid=禁忌 / precaution=谨慎 / safe_with_modification=可做需改造 / recommended=推荐 / ineffective_for_target=对该目标无效

name: query_safety_boundaries

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: query_safety_boundaries
